text.text_excerpt: This hotel was fantastic. Right in the middle of everything in the French Quarter - on Bienville, a block from Bourbon Street. We requested a courtyard room after reading reviews about noisy nights if you stay in a room on Bienville Street. We got a cozy room tucked into the back courtyard. Bed was outstanding. Super comfy and soft, with a down like comforter. The room AC was set on a cool 60 -- which was highly appreciated. New Orleans is such a hot, humid city, that this AC was heaven sent. Floors are marble, shower was big and roomy. Breakfast was complimentary, (which saves a few bucks) - waffles, pancakes, eggs, grits, fruit salad, toast, english muffins, bagels, croissants, yogurt, ...

We booked a room for a mid-week stay two weeks ago. It was our second stay at the hotel & it was just as good as the first. We had friends with us this time & we both booked rooms with balconies. I made a note when booking & the manager arranged rooms next to each other with a shared balcony. It really made for great evening people watching. As before, the rooms were immaculate & kept that way by the staff for our entire visit. The rooms are beautifully appointed with huge bathrooms. All the amenities we needed were available & we were so comfortable it was a little hard to leave. The morning breakfast is one of my favorite parts. Eggs, sausage, bacon, grits, pastries, bagels, fresh fruit...

Thanks hotel Mazarin! All of youre employees were so wonderful. We had a mix up in our reservations and without a doubt they took care of us and made the situation. My two best friends and I visited this hotel and felt comfortable and safe. The beds were great and the complimentary breakfast was surprisingly delicious. Choose from their gorgeous courtyard or their speak easy in house bar to chill before hitting the town. So central to everything in NOLA. We walked everywhere
